title: Rewire lint cartography, introduce staged toolchain lease, and add lightweight release safeguard
author: Asha Patel
merge_outcome: Merged after approvals and green CI. Small follow-up chore scheduled to remove feature flag.
description: Motivation: Our presubmit lanes and release hooks have grown ad-hoc around various lint rule sets and developer toolchain versions which leads to spurious failures and slow feedback. This PR reorganizes lint rule ownership (lint cartography), adds a lightweight staged toolchain lease to reduce presubmit image churn, and introduces a minimal release safeguard that verifies provenance metadata before signing/releasing artifacts. What this PR does: 1) Introduces a lint cartography manifest that maps lint rules and rule-sets to repo subtrees and owners; the mapping is used by presubmit to run targeted lint shards rather than the full monorepo lint when changes touch small areas. 2) Adds a toolchain lease service (ci/toolchain/lease.go, runtime shim and GH Action wrapper) that grants ephemeral toolchain leases for presubmit runners so cached microimages are reused across related PRs. 3) Implements a release-safeguard check in our release workflow that validates artifact provenance headers and KMS signing eligibility; it fails releases that don't have the expected provenance but logs a clear remediation path. 4) Adds a gradual dev-dependency rotation helper that automates staged updates of devDeps via a small presubmit-friendly bot; dev-dep updates are batched by package-owner group as defined in the lint cartography manifest. Rollout plan: feature gated behind ci.flags.lint_cartography and ci.flags.toolchain_lease. Step 1 (canary): enable lint_cartography for the redwood/* packages for 2 weeks and observe presubmit runtime and false-positive rate. Step 2: enable toolchain_lease in the presubmit runners for at-most-10 concurrent leases and measure cache hit rate. Step 3: enable release_safeguard in pre-release environments for non-prod releases for 1 month, then flip for production. Testing: unit tests added for lease logic and cartography parser; presubmit smoke job added to validate targeted lint shards; e2e on a pinned small repo subset. Backwards compatibility: all changes are opt-in via flags and default to existing behavior. Checklist: - [x] lint cartography manifest + parser - [x] presubmit integration to shard lint by affected areas - [x] toolchain lease service + GH Action wrapper - [x] release-safeguard added to release workflow with clear remediation logs - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] documentation in docs/ci/tooling.md Links: Linear ENG-2271 (lint cartography), ENG-2309 (toolchain lease). Notes: This is intentionally lightweight; it is not a full replacement of our CI orchestration. The goal is to reduce noise and speed up the common small-change feedback path. If you are a package owner and see your rules remapped, please file ENG-2309 with examples of false positives.
